g.text: Applicant - It’s an application for a vacancy by a candidate, regardless if internal or external.
The Identifier of the Person record.
The Identifier of the Job Vacancy record.
Indicates if the applicant is already an employee.
E’ un punteggio numerico, una percentuale, che indica l’aderenza tra il candidato e l’offerta di lavoro.
Indicates where the Candidate comes from. If for example it is an external candidate that was shortlisted through an ATS like Arca24, the source will be Arca24.

g.title: HR_CANDIDATE
g.text: This is a small verson of the Person's picture, obtained by cropping and reducing the original in size.
The Person's given, or first, name.

Contains a non-given name. This is an inherited name or one representing a family relationship or in some cultural contexts a Place Name (where someone is from). In some cultural contexts, a single family name is typical, while in others there may be multiple family names. A primary attribute may be used in the case where there are multiple last names. A family name can have a prefix, such as Von, De, Van, Al, etc. These can be represented using the Family Name Prefix field. Not all implementers may find it necessary to separate prefixes from the family name itself. Capturing the prefix and Family Name as discrete fields can become important when formatting or appearance may vary based on context. For example, in some cultural contexts it may be common to use a blank space as the delimiter between the prefix and the family name, while in others a hyphen might be used. Separating the prefix from Family Name allows such formatting requirements to be handled flexibly.
A previous family name, such as a maiden name, which is a family name prior to marriage and assuming a spouse's name.

An identifier issued to a person by a government organization. For example, a social insurance number or driver's license number. The schemeName typically would be used to reference the type of identifier (e.g., SSN, NC Drivers License) and the schemeAgencyID would be used to identify the issuing agency as necessary.
The Identifier of the Document Type record.

This is the complete name of a person, made up of the constituent parts (i.e. Family Name, Given Name). The formatCode is an optional attribute which specifies the applicable format. In the case of the Formatted Name of a person, some example formatCodes could be: ''Family Name, Given Name'', ''Given Name Middle Initial Family Name'' or ''First Initial. Family Name''.
A code specifying gender. This list includes NotSpecified, which is different from the OAGIS gender list.
The date on which the person was born.
The Identifier of the Nationality record.
Indicates if the candidate is already an employee.
The Identifier of the Person record.
The person who referred the candidate.
Indicates the city of an address.
The Identifier of the Country record.
Indicates the province of the city of an address.
The primary or preferred language associated with a person or work environment.
Indicates the education title provided by the course.
The date the degree was achieved.
Study Level, such as primary, secondary school etc.
The Industry sector of the Company, for example Manufacturing, Energy etc.
The main Job Title covered during the work experience.
Indicates the start date of the last job.
Indicates the end date of the last job.
Indicates the name of the Employer Organisation, for example ACME Inc.
Indicates that the record is anonymous.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_PERSON
g.text: Person - Contains information identifying the person.
The Person's given, or first, name.

Contains a non-given name. This is an inherited name or one representing a family relationship or in some cultural contexts a Place Name (where someone is from). In some cultural contexts, a single family name is typical, while in others there may be multiple family names. .
A previous family name, such as a maiden name, which is a family name prior to marriage and assuming a spouse's name.
The name by which the person prefers to be called.
Contains a preferred form of address or salutation. For, example, Mr, Mrs, Ms, Dr, etc.
A letter or series of letters representing the first letter in each name part.
Could be used to accompany the name of the person with some descent title.
Usually an abreviation representing a qualification (a degree or certification, for example) held by a person. For example, BA, BSc, Beng, MSc, MD, RN, CPA, PhD, etc.
A portion of a name indicating generation Sr., Jr., III (the third), etc.

This is the complete name of a person, made up of the constituent parts (i.e. Family Name, Given Name). The formatCode is an optional attribute which specifies the applicable format. In the case of the Formatted Name of a person, some example formatCodes could be: ''Family Name, Given Name'', ''Given Name Middle Initial Family Name'' or ''First Initial. Family Name''.

Legal name used for legal documentation or other legal purposes. Contains, in one string, a fully formatted name with all of its pieces in their proper place. This includes all of the necessary punctuation.

An identifier issued to a person by a government organization. For example, a social insurance number or driver's license number. The schemeName typically would be used to reference the type of identifier (e.g., SSN, NC Drivers License) and the schemeAgencyID would be used to identify the issuing agency as necessary.
The Identifier of the Document Type record.
A code specifying gender. This list includes NotSpecified, which is different from the OAGIS gender list.
The date on which the person was born.
Indicates the place where the person was born.
Indicates the County where a person was born.
Indicates the City where a person was born.

A set of codes classifying a person's marital status. This is an HR-XML Open List. Standard effective dating and a certified date are available as attributes. Enumerated values are: Domestic Partner Divorced Married Unreported Separated Unmarried Widowed Legally Separated.

A code classifiying a person's current or past military status. Depending on the use case and applicable law, employers may need to track a varity of different information regarding a person's current or military status. Under applicable law, current or prior military personnel may be entitled to certain employment preferences.
The date on which the associated person died.
The primary or preferred language associated with a person or work environment.
The Identifier of the Nationality record.

A code classifying a person on the basis of their ethnicity. Ethnicity pertains to having common racial, cultural, religious, or linguistic characteristics. Ethnicity classifications may be relevant under government labor or fair employment practice regulations. For example, under U.S. record keeping rules for federal Contractors employers may require reporting of data with respect to whether or not a person is of Hispanic or Latino ethnicity, a classification which encompass persons of Mexican, Puerto Rican, Cuban, Central or South American, or other Spanish culture or origin, regardless of race.
The Identifier of the Race record.
Indicates if the Person is a smoker.

An indicator as to whether the Person is currently enrolled as a student within a specific class of educational institution. This is component is attributed with effective dating. A typeCode attribute is available to make fine-grain distinctions such as Full Time or Part Time status.
Used in Portugal. It is another way to format the full name of the Person.
This field contains the full Personal Picture, before any crop.
This is a small verson of the Person's picture, obtained by cropping and reducing the original in size.
This field can be used by an Employee to introduce themselves.
Indicates if the person has a valid Driving License.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_JOBVACANCY
g.text: Job Vacancy - Includes the Job, the candidate ideal profile, the text of the advert, economical and contractual conditions offered, Job location etc.
When this flag is active, the Job Vacancy is meant to target only internal employees for internal movements and it is not supposed to be published outside the company for candidate application.
The Identifier of the OrgUnit record.
The Identifier of the Job record.
The Identifier of the Job Class record.
The Identifier of the Working Time Pattern record.
The Identifier of the Location record.
The first line of the Address.
The second line of the Address.
The third line of the Address.
The fourth line of the Address.
The fifth line of the Address.
The Identifier of the City record.
The Identifier of the Country record.
The Identifier of the State / Province record.
The Identifier of the Contract Type record.
The length of the Relationship Period, expressed in a specific Time Unit (weeks, days etc.).
Time Unit the Contract duration is expressed with.
It’s a condition expressed on any dimension, including CV but also current and past employments.
The Identifier of the Currency record.
Date the Vacancy was created on.
This field shows the job vacancy published date created on an external portal. If the job vacancy is internal shows the date when it has set online.
Date the Job Vacancy is supposed to go offline.
This is the set of selection steps that can be used for this Job Vacancy.
Indicates if this vacancy is accessible for application only to external candidates, only to employees or both.
The person who the request is entitled to.
This is the URI that can be used to navigate to the ATS. From here, it is possible to complete some operations like, for example, publishing on job boards.
This is the URI that can be used to navigate to the ATS to see the list of applicants.
This is the URI that can be used to navigate to the ATS to see the Job Vacancy as the final candidate will do.
All external candidates in an interview stage. In this stage we can find candidates answering to killer questions, recording a video CV or just being scheduled for a phone call.
All external candidates having passed all interview steps and being selected. From the selected stage, it is possible to optionally go into the “shortlist”, where candidates can be hired from.

If checked, any applicants moved to the “Selection” Status will be assigned the Selection Steps as defined in the Job Vacancy. If not checked, the Selection Steps will not be generated, but it's still possible to use a process to schedule a Selection Step linked to a Job Vacancy Step Outline
If checked, then if all the Selections Step for an Applicant are successfully completed, the Applicant will be automatically moved to the Shortlist.

This is the Manager responsible for the Recruitment process. When specified, this field identifies which managerial profile will have access to the job vacancy, in addition to any manager who created a Hiring Request linked to it.
This field contains the technical skills required for the profile sought.
This field contains the name of the company associated with the campaign

g.title: HR_SELECTIONSTEP
g.text: Selection Step - Indicates step in the selection process, for a selected candidate. Includes the date of the appointment, who will do the interview and the outcome.
The identifier of the Applicant record.
The identifier of the Job Vacancy Outline Step record.
Indicates if the Selection Step has been completed.
Step Type, for example First Interview, Second Interview, chosen from a catalog.
It’s the outcome of the selection step, chosen from a catalog of options.
Indicates who in the organization will conduct the interview.
It’s the external outcome of the selection step
The identifier of Rating Scale code.
This is the score expressed as a percentage.
The minimum required score percentage to pass the step if it is set as a questionnaire.
This field stores the reference to a questionnaire from the catalogue.
